request_without_reference_paths.prompt: Create ONE original Observatory building for the same stylized strategy-game civilization as the reference Memory Archive. Use the reference as architectural and material art direction, not the building to copy. A compact polygonal stepped warm pale limestone podium supports a slender observation tower, with broad dark slate eaves and aged copper trim. Crown it with one substantial fixed optical instrument or lens housing integrated into the masonry, with a subtle turquoise glass accent. The silhouette must read as observation and telemetry, not a temple, library lantern, modern radar dish or lighthouse. Taller and more slender than the Archive, with a few broad clear terraces, not a stack of tiny floors. Use solid closed surfaces, simple shallow rectangular window panels and thick reliable architectural members; no punched-out windows, latticework, thin railings, cables or floating pieces. Readable from elevated isometric strategy-game cameras. Show the complete standalone building in one clean elevated three-quarter view, plain neutral background, no ground tile or scenery, no people, text or logos, no dramatic baked lighting or excessive grime.
